description: A passwordless sign-in screen that runs a simulated face scan in a dialog, then welcomes the user.
overview: A passwordless sign-in screen with an account chip, a Continue with passkey button and a fallback link to sign in with a password. Starting the flow opens a small dialog with a scanning animation that turns into a check mark, then the screen welcomes the user. Use it as the front door for passkey or biometric login.
usage: The scan is faked with timers in `start`; replace it with a WebAuthn call such as `navigator.credentials.get` and move to the welcome state when it resolves. Replace the account email, initials and welcome name, and point the `#change` and `#password` links at your routes.
notes: Closing the dialog cancels the pending timers; abort your WebAuthn request the same way when the user cancels.
